method.policy: Class-specific shared Dark body geometry. Preserve the existing nominal size-class selector and large centered policy. Select on 28 of 30 existing training printings after checking original wording. Exclude Goblin Wizard and Ghost Ship from fit selection because their original activation colons needed correction. The 87 validation printings are reused validation, not an unseen holdout.
method.pose: Reuse frozen frame-only scan normalization; no text-driven scan alignment or per-card layout offsets.
method.isolation: 316 full native cards, 121 exact warm prototypes, 194 unchanged ARN/ATQ controls, 84 unchanged controls across twelve other sets. Corrected original wording is identical before/after for the two colon repairs; Oracle data is unchanged.
method.sizeClasses: Regular short uses at most five lines in the unchanged original regular layout. Compact selection uses the unchanged nominal layout, so spacing cannot promote a compact printing to regular type.
method.rejectedCandidate: An earlier global spacing fit changed compact cards into regular-size text. Rejected before integration; this candidate preserves every measured size class.
method.limitations: Ball Lightning has rejected frame normalization and is unscored. Gaea’s Touch 77† is a printing-shift diagnostic. Retain all text and full-card regressions. Source styling, wrapping and ink weight are not certified across every printing.
method.fullMetric: Normalize native 732x1020 renders to 488x680 before applying printing-structure-v1. Broad report frame strips overlap body text, so their score can change even though native isolation proves zero changed pixels outside the body. Structural scores are similarity indices, not correctness percentages.
